```{r}
vcf <- read.vcfR("../../../../../../nextcloud/2024-2027_Paul_PhD/01.data/01.SNPs_VCF_faba_collection/filtered_for_confirmation.vcf")
vcf_gt <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT")
vcf_gt[vcf_gt %in% c("0/0", "0|0")] <- 0
vcf_gt[vcf_gt %in% c("0/1", "1/0", "0|1", "1|0")] <- 1
vcf_gt[vcf_gt %in% c("1/1", "1|1")] <- 2
vcf_gt[vcf_gt %in% c("./.", ".|.")] <- NA

vcf_gt <- apply(vcf_gt, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(vcf_gt) <- rownames(vcf_gt)
hap <-read.csv("liste_favorable_state/Sheet 2-Table 1.csv", sep=";")

haplotypes <- unique(hap$Haplotype)

result <- data.frame(Genotype = colnames(vcf_gt))

for(h in haplotypes){

  sub <- subset(hap, Haplotype == h)

  snps <- sub$SNP
  expected <- sub$Value

  present <- snps %in% rownames(vcf_gt)

  gt <- vcf_gt[snps[present], , drop = FALSE]

  expected <- expected[present]

  status <- apply(gt, 2, function(x){

  # HARD safety check
  if(length(x) != length(expected)){
    return("Unfavorable")
  }

  if (isTRUE(all(x == expected))) {
    "Favorable"
  } else {
    "Unfavorable"
  }
})

  result[[h]] <- status
}

```



```{r}
library(vcfR)

# ----------------------------
# 1. READ VCF + EXTRACT GT
# ----------------------------
vcf <- read.vcfR("../../../../../../nextcloud/2024-2027_Paul_PhD/01.data/01.SNPs_VCF_faba_collection/filtered_for_confirmation.vcf")

vcf_gt <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT")

# convert genotypes to dosage
vcf_gt[vcf_gt %in% c("0/0", "0|0")] <- 0
vcf_gt[vcf_gt %in% c("0/1", "1/0", "0|1", "1|0")] <- 1
vcf_gt[vcf_gt %in% c("1/1", "1|1")] <- 2
vcf_gt[vcf_gt %in% c("./.", ".|.")] <- NA

vcf_gt <- apply(vcf_gt, 2, as.numeric)

# IMPORTANT: SNP IDs must come from FIX columns
rownames(vcf_gt) <- getFIX(vcf)[,"ID"]


# ----------------------------
# 2. READ HAPLOTYPE FILE
# ----------------------------
hap <- read.csv(
  "liste_favorable_state/Sheet 2-Table 1.csv",
  sep = ";"
)

hap$Value <- as.numeric(hap$Value)
haplotypes <- unique(hap$Haplotype)


# ----------------------------
# 3. RESULT TABLE
# ----------------------------
result <- data.frame(Genotype = colnames(vcf_gt))


# ----------------------------
# 4. LOOP OVER HAPLOTYPES
# ----------------------------
for(h in haplotypes){

  sub <- subset(hap, Haplotype == h)

  snps <- sub$SNP
  expected <- as.numeric(sub$Value)

  present <- snps %in% rownames(vcf_gt)

  cat("\nHaplotype:", h,
      " total SNPs:", length(snps),
      " matched:", sum(present))

  # skip if nothing matches
  if(sum(present) == 0){
    result[[h]] <- rep("Unfavorable", ncol(vcf_gt))
    next
  }

  # subset and align
  gt <- vcf_gt[snps[present], , drop = FALSE]
  expected <- expected[present]

  # enforce identical ordering
  expected <- expected[match(rownames(gt), snps[present])]

  # ----------------------------
  # 5. COMPARE
  # ----------------------------
  status <- apply(gt, 2, function(x){

    # strict safety check
    if(length(x) != length(expected)){
      return("Unfavorable")
    }

    if(isTRUE(all(x == expected, na.rm = FALSE))){
      "Favorable"
    } else {
      "Unfavorable"
    }

  })

  result[[h]] <- status
}


# ----------------------------
# 6. SAVE OUTPUT
# ----------------------------
#write.csv(result, "haplotype_status.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

merged_fabae <- merged %>%
  filter(is.na(emmeans_fabae))
merged_fabae<-merged_fabae[,-c(6:9)]
# Count "Favorable" in columns 2 to 5 for each row
n_favorable_fabae <- rowSums(merged_fabae[, 2:5] == "Favorable")

# Count how many rows have 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4 Favorable values
table(n_favorable_fabae)

  filter(is.na(emmeans_pisum))
```
